what: AU Hawk tuning (br-bwju.12): the doughnut from a roll. As roster-doughnut but hawk-dash starts rolling at 6 m/s, so the Hawk Dash, which can only start a power slide above 2 m/s, gets its slide too: the AU Hawk still out-circles it.
